evidence: Static-text row; no runtime evidence is required. Skill procedure (quality-checks.md:13-15) asks for sentence variety, contractions and terse fragments, and lists as defects uniform cadence, marketing gloss, perfectly parallel bullets, or a voice that changes between instruction.md and the notes. instruction.md is continuous first-person prose with no bullets, headings or tables. It opens as a spoken request (instruction.md:1 'Can you build HireOps into a compensation change desk?'), mixes short and long sentences (instruction.md:7 'All of that before anything is saved.' is a fragment; instruction.md:1 'the exchange is affordable as a whole, but neither move can happen first'), and uses contractions (instruction.md:5 'We don't need a dashboard'; instruction.md:15 'so don't install packages', 'mustn't depend', 'if it's set') and idiom (instruction.md:7 'The change desk is somewhere we work, not just a form we submit'; instruction.md:5 'the layout and names are yours'; instruction.md:15 'is your call'). A case-insensitive grep for seamless|robust|delve|leverage|ensure|comprehensive|intuitive|streamlin over instruction.md and both notes returned no hits. The notes share the same register (hireops_rules.md section 1: 'What keeps catching us out isn't any single screen'; section 12: 'Layout, wording and mechanism are yours'), so there is no voice change between brief and notes. Residual, non-blocking observations: (a) instruction.md:13 and :17 drop into a clipped imperative register ('Preserve the one stored reference moment, integer arithmetic and calendar conventions.'; 'Start with no shipped database, seed once, and retain new work on later restarts.') that reads as appended requirement patches rather than the speaker of lines 1-11; (b) the speaker alternates 'I' (7) and 'we' within paragraphs, and 'must' appears 7 times. These are terse rather than robotic or glossy, and terse is explicitly acceptable under the workbook wording, so they do not reach the defect threshold. Weak/alternative test: a perfectly parallel bulleted rewrite would fail this row and the current text is not that; a more casual rewrite would also pass, so the row is not over-constraining.
